content:
**Packin' Light** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Action Points regenerate faster when not overencumbered. It gives 25% AP regeneration when not overencumbered.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Your Action Points regenerate faster when not over encumbered. | 0031E523 |
